title: Delete or re-target calendar_program_service_ref_extraction_test.dart — tests hand-duplicated logic absent from production

evidence.quote: /// The actual method is private, so we test the same extraction algorithm
/// Historically orchestrated Sefaria + Hebcal API calls with a 24-hour

why: This 66-line file has no import of any production symbol — its only import is flutter_test itself — because it defines and tests its own hand-copied reimplementation of a once-private URL-parsing method. That method no longer exists anywhere: `grep -rn sefaria.org lib/` returns zero hits, and CalendarProgramService's own docstring confirms why — after Story 19.4 it is 'a thin delegate over LocalCalendarEngine: every call is a local-DB read, no network traffic, no JSON parsing, no cache.' The test can never fail regardless of what CalendarProgramService actually does, so it gives false confidence that Sefaria-ref extraction is covered when there is zero real coverage.
recommendation: Delete the file — the logic and its risk surface are gone from production. If Sefaria-URL ref extraction still matters somewhere (e.g. a build-time seed-generation script under tool/), point a new test at that real symbol instead.
acceptance_criteria: File removed from test/ (or rewritten to import and exercise a real, currently-live production symbol)
flutter test / make test-all-stories stays green with no coverage claimed for the removed dead code

corrections: None needed; all cited evidence reproduced exactly.
